title: Returns by fiduciaries.
bodyText: The returns, statements, or answers required under chapters of the law under title 14 administered by the department shall be made, in the form and manner prescribed by the department, by the personal representative, trustee, guardian, or other fiduciary in such capacity.
bodyHtml: §231-15.7  Returns by fiduciaries.  The returns, statements, or answers required under chapters of the law under title 14 administered by the department shall be made, in the form and manner prescribed by the department, by the personal representative, trustee, guardian, or other fiduciary in such capacity. [L 1989, c 14, §1(5); am L 1991, c 263, §7; am L 1994, c 16, §2; am L 1995, c 66, §7; am L 2021, c 117, §3]
